api_checks.description: E5-S1 AC1 / F017: agent posts an article from a RESOLVED source ticket -> 201, source_ticket_id fixed to that ticket.
E5-S1 AC2: posting from an OPEN source ticket -> 409 SOURCE_TICKET_NOT_RESOLVED.
E5-S1 AC3 / F018: customer POST/PUT/DELETE on /api/kb/articles each return 403 and leave the article table unchanged. All three methods verified live on the same article id.

F021: priority/status/escalated query params each narrow the result to exactly the matching tickets in that queue. Verified live against a queue whose membership is stable across repeated reads (billing-tier-2, already fully escalated) to avoid the SLA evaluate-and-escalate side effect of GET itself changing queue membership between calls on a still-breaching queue.
F022: customer call -> 403; an unknown queue slug (as agent) -> 404 NOT_FOUND. Both verified live.
F024: login response includes role and username for all three roles.
F023: GET /api/admin/dashboard?from&to returns the three report sections; 403 for non-admin; 422 when to < from. All three verified live.

E6-S2 AC1: a new version is created and a follow-up GET /api/admin/sla-policies?priority=High lists it first (newest-first). PATCH/PUT/DELETE on a published version id still return 409 POLICY_VERSION_IMMUTABLE (re-verified live in this group, already covered by Group C's F019/F020).
